# skycloak_realm_group (Resource)

A realm group. Add users with `skycloak_realm_group_membership`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_group" "engineering" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  name       = "engineering"
}

resource "skycloak_realm_group" "backend" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  name       = "backend"
  parent_id  = skycloak_realm_group.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Group name (leaf segment of the path).
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `parent_id` (String) Parent group ID for a nested group. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `path` (String) Canonical group path.
